actors.name: Riverton city council
actors.private_context: The council has a short-term-rental ordinance that has passed first reading. The council's internal rules require a second reading before final passage. The council is aware of the approaching August recess starting August 15, 2026. Some members may have scheduling conflicts or differing priorities regarding the ordinance.

starting_events.description: The Riverton city council is in session and aware that the short-term-rental ordinance requires a second reading before the August recess.
